<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="melee-upgrade-order-ability-bars" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Upgrade Order &amp; Ability Bars</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel lists the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>general</nowiki></strong><nowiki> natural combat style progression template for new players to follow devised by the RuneScape Discord Luminaries in collaboration with PVME. ‎ ‎From levels 1 - 50, where an item is marked P2P, this means it is a members item.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Last Revised: 13 April 2024</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Strength </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are the two combat skills that define melee combat in Runescape.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ General notes:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> affects accuracy and its level is what determines what melee weapons you can equip.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Strength </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> determines your damage dealt with melee weapons.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The best defence is a good offence: weapon upgrades take precedence over armour upgrades!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• As you get stronger, dual wield becomes better for single target combat and Two-handed (2H) for multi-way combat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To </nowiki><strong><nowiki>switch xp gain</nowiki></strong><nowiki> between </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: Settings → Gameplay → Combat &amp; Action bar → Combat XP. Tick the skills to enable how you want the XP focused.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>All bars assume &quot;Revolution++&quot; is being used:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Settings → Gameplay → Combat &amp; Action bar. Activate revolution, make the revo outline cover 10 slots, and tick the boxes for thresholds and ultimate abilities.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="levels-1-20"><ins><nowiki>Levels 1 - 20</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="gear"><nowiki>Gear:</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 1 ‎ ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Bronze 2h sword or Bronze halberd; or </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Reese%27s_sword <nowiki>Reese's sword</nowiki>]<nowiki> &amp; </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Reese%27s_off-hand_sword <nowiki>Reese's off-hand sword</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Latter are free from the quest </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Blood_Pact/Quick_guide <nowiki>Blood Pact</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 5 ‎ ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Keenblade <nowiki>Keenblade</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Free from </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Gudrik <nowiki>Gudrik</nowiki>]<nowiki> in Port Sarim</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 20 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Steel 2h sword or Steel halberd; or Steel dagger, mace, or warhammer + off-hand.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Armour</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 1 ‎ ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Pathfinder armour</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This armour is free and can be obtained from </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Gudrik <nowiki>Gudrik</nowiki>]<nowiki> in Port Sarim.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 20 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Steel armour</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amulet of strength</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Bladestorm_drape <nowiki>Bladestorm drape</nowiki>]<nowiki> - Best in Slot cape for F2P</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Silverhawk_boots <nowiki>Silverhawk boots</nowiki>]<nowiki> (</nowiki><em><nowiki>non-ironman &amp; P2P</nowiki></em><nowiki>) can be freely claimed from the Marketplace and give a small damage boost.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The boots can be upgraded at lvl 20, 40, 50 and 60 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> respectively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ability-bars-levels-1-20"><nowiki>Ability bars levels 1 - 20 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>These bars assume you are training Attack and Strength at the same time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use the lesser abilities as placeholders. These will update automatically as you unlock the full ability.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Bar at 1 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: For Dual-Wield swap </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1217207451536068628.png?v=1" alt="lessersmash" title="lessersmash" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1217207450273448137.png?v=1" alt="lesserhavoc" title="lesserhavoc" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/yrnmiJkWcN.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At level 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> add </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to Spot 1 on your bar</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At level 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> remove </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854302605333.png?v=1" alt="backhand" title="backhand" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and add </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879552315412.png?v=1" alt="stomp" title="stomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to ‎ ‎Spot 4 on your bar</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At level 8 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> add </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1" alt="punish" title="punish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to ‎ ‎Spot 7 on your bar</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>At level 20 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, your bar will look like the bar below:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/yVmqC5tt3X.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="monsters-to-kill-1-20"><nowiki>Monsters to kill 1 - 20 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /></h3>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="levels-20-50"><ins><nowiki>Levels 20 - 50</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Smithable gear will start having +1/+2/+3 upgrades. These improve their stats slightly but are generally not worth it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Halberds <nowiki>Halberds</nowiki>]<nowiki> are recommended for training on groups of enemies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="gear_1"><nowiki>Gear:</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 30 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Mithril 2h sword (F2P) or Mithril halberd (P2P)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 40 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Adamant 2h sword (F2P) or Adamant halberd (P2P)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 50 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Rune 2h sword (F2P) or Rune halberd (P2P)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/764086050959392778.png?v=1" alt="iron" title="iron" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: Rune halberd can bought in </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Scavvo%27s_Rune_Store <nowiki>Champion's guild</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Armour</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 50 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Rock-shell_armour <nowiki>Rockshell armour</nowiki>]<nowiki> (P2P) &gt; Rune armour (F2P)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Former requires completion of the quest </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Fremennik_Trials/Quick_guide <nowiki>The Fremennik Trials</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Obsidian cape (P2P) or </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Cape_of_legends <nowiki>Cape of legends</nowiki>]<nowiki> (P2P)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Latter requires completion of the quest </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Legends%27_Quest/Quick_guide <nowiki>Legends Quest</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amulet of glory (P2P)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Explorer%27s_ring_3 <nowiki>Explorer's ring 3</nowiki>]<nowiki> (F2P) or Ring of Wealth (P2P)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Former requires completion of the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Medium_Lumbridge_achievements <nowiki>medium Lumbridge achievements</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Silverhawk_boots <nowiki>Silverhawk boots</nowiki>]<nowiki> (</nowiki><em><nowiki>non-ironman &amp; P2P</nowiki></em><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The boots can be upgraded at lvl 20, 40, 50 and 60 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ability-bars-levels-20-50"><nowiki>Ability bars levels 20 - 50 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>These bars assume you are training Attack and Strength at the same time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Bar at 20 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: For Dual-Wield swap </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879820619786.png?v=1" alt="smash" title="smash" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879300526080.png?v=1" alt="havoc" title="havoc" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/yVmqC5tt3X.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ At level 24 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> add </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879510372352.png?v=1" alt="fury" title="fury" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to Spot 5 on your bar.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At level 37 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> remove </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>If 2H:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At level 37 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> add </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1" alt="quake" title="quake" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to Spot 2 on your bar</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At level 48 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> add </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1" alt="cleave" title="cleave" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to Spot 2 on your bar</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>If DW:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At level 37 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> add </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1" alt="destroy" title="destroy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to Spot 2 on your bar.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>At level 50 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, your bar will look like the bar below:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="frequently-asked-questions"><ins><nowiki>Frequently asked questions</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>⬥ Some dual wield weapons have more damage bonus than others. Are they better?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• No. When using abilities, weapons of the same tier deal the same amount of damage. Weapon speed and damage bonus together make it deal identical ability damage in the end.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can safely mix different types of main hand and off-hand weapons.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>⬥ Why is two-handed recommended over dual wield?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2H melee is better in multi-target situations than Dual-Wield, and therefore often lead to faster levelling.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ‎ ‎Flurry </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492981763702834.png?v=1" alt="flurry" title="flurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (37 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki>), Quake </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1" alt="quake" title="quake" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (36 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki>), Cleave </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1" alt="cleave" title="cleave" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (48 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="strength" title="strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki>), and hurricane </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (55 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="attack" title="attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) are multi-target attacks, often called Area-of-Effect (AoE) abilities, that hit multiple nearby monsters.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These are 2H abilities (except for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492981763702834.png?v=1" alt="flurry" title="flurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) and benefit greatly from halberd's larger attack range.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Can I just train slayer?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You certainly can if you want some variety. It is, however, slower to train at lower combat levels.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>⬥ Why are weapons upgrades more important than armour upgrades? / Why is power armour recommended over tank armour?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frankly put: You gain more from hitting harder than from getting hit less. A higher tier weapon lets you hit harder by increasing hit chance and damage bonus. Power armour increases damage bonus too. This lets you hit harder and kill more monsters, which means more xp gained per hour.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>
